title: TenantPractitionerLocationResponse
description: Combined schema representing a practitioner's location within a tenant group, including all location details, tenant group associations, and practitioner-specific information.

suppressSiteFromDirectory.description: Controls whether this location should be hidden from public directories and provider listings.

active.description: Indicates if the location is currently active and operational.

terminationDate.description: The date when the association was terminated.

billingEffectiveDate.description: The effective date for billing purposes.

billingTerminationDate.description: The termination date for billing purposes.

effectiveStartDate.description: The start date when this record becomes effective.

effectiveEndDate.description: The end date when this record is no longer effective.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this is the primary location for the practitioner.

roleType.description: The role type of the practitioner at this location.

panelStatus.description: The current panel status for the practitioner at this location.

acceptingNewPatients.description: Indicates if the practitioner is accepting new patients at this location.

effectiveDate.description: The date when this record becomes effective.

npdbEnrollmentEnabled.description: Indicates if NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank) enrollment is enabled.

locationType.description: Specifies the primary type of healthcare services provided at this location

hasAdmittingPrivileges.description: Indicates whether healthcare providers at this location have the authority to admit patients to affiliated hospitals

acceptsNewPatients.description: Indicates whether the location is currently accepting new patient appointments or registrations

isPrimaryLocation.description: Indicates whether this is the main practice location for the healthcare provider or group

adaCompliance.description: Americans with Disabilities Act compliance information for the location

officeHours.description: Operating hours for each day of the week

locationHsdSpecialty.description: Healthcare service delivery specialty designation for this location

locationPrimarySpecialty.description: Primary medical specialty or focus area of the location

limitationsForMembers.description: List of any restrictions or limitations that apply to members at this location

tags.description: Custom labels or categories associated with this location

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created this location record

createdByName.description: Name of the user who created this location record

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the user who last updated this location record

updatedByName.description: Name of the user who last updated this location record

contacts.description: List of contact information for the location

afterHoursPhoneNumber.description: Phone number to be used outside of regular business hours

email.description: Primary email address for contact communications

mainPhoneNumber.description: Primary contact phone number during regular business hours

name.description: Full name or title of the contact person or department

addresses.description: List of addresses associated with the location

addressLine1.description: Primary address line containing street number, street name, and apartment/suite if applicable

addressLine2.description: Secondary address line for additional address information (building name, floor, etc.)

city.description: Name of the city or municipality

country.description: Country name or code where the address is located

county.description: County or district name within the state/province

zip.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the address

AdaCompliance.description: Americans with Disabilities Act compliance details

handicapAccessible.description: Indicates if the location is accessible to people with disabilities

handicapParking.description: Indicates if designated handicap parking spaces are available

handicapRestroom.description: Indicates if ADA-compliant restroom facilities are available

OfficeHour.description: Operating hours for a specific day of the week

openTime.description: Time when the location opens on this day

closeTime.description: Time when the location closes on this day

closed.description: Indicates if the location is closed on this day
